{{Quote|There are several likely gas giant worlds in remote systems that might have the Tibanna we need. I want you to survey those planets and find us a Tibanna deposit.|Captain Eedan, to a group of Rebel Alliance agents|<ref name="Journal5" />}}
The '''Lequabis system''' was a remote [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Journal5" /> located in the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] portion of<ref name="Expansion" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained at least one [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Journal5" />

Shortly after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of<ref name="Journal5" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]<ref name="TEA" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}}, which includes the [[occupation of Bespin]], to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which until then had been acquiring [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]] from Cloud City for use with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]], was forced to seek other sources of Tibanna. To that end, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Eedan]] of the Alliance's [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] section tasked a group of Rebel agents with [[Scout/Legends|surveying]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] giants in several [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and Expansion Region [[Star/Legends|star]] systems for any deposits of Tibanna.<ref name="Journal5" />

The group explored the Lequabis system in its modified [[YT-700 transport|YT-700 Transport]], the ''[[Jackpot]]'', but found no usable Tibanna deposits there. The Rebel scouts then continued with the search in<ref name="Journal5" /> the Expansion Region's<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Poviduze system/Legends|Poviduze system]].<ref name="Journal5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lequabis system was first mentioned in "[[Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]," an article published in the [[February]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine. The article was written by [[James L. Cambias]] and contained a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Journal5" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the star system within grid square I-14.<ref name="TEA" />
